publication_policy.evidence: Archived 2004 qlsn.com newspaper introduction states: 4开4版，彩色印刷，每周二出版；月末出版相应的A、B、C、D版。

primary_date_anchor.evidence: Official qlsn.com forum correction states ‘2010年的6月8日第924期吧’.

independent_cross_check.evidence: Official editor blog published a post titled ‘我和《齐鲁少年》的故事 为齐鲁少年创刊1000期而作’ on 2011-11-22. This is exactly 76 weekly increments after issue 924 on 2010-06-08.

method: For other issue numbers, publication_date = 2010-06-08 + 7 * (issue_number - 924) days. Such dates are labeled inferred_weekly rather than verified/direct.
cross_checks: Issue 740 infers 2006-11-28; its recovered qlsn.com article was posted 2006-12-11 and explicitly identifies 第740期.
Issue 745 infers 2007-01-02; three recovered qlsn.com article pages were posted 2007-01-18 and explicitly identify 齐鲁少年（745期）.
2009 official-home issue paths are normally posted days after the inferred Tuesday issue date, consistent with website republication/update lag.
Issue 898 infers 2009-12-08, resolving a raw forum-miner misclassification caused by a 2010-01-06 sample-copy request.
Issues 965 and 967 infer 2011 dates and are therefore excluded from the 2010 issue set.
caution: This timeline is a reconstruction aid for locating scans and external reposts. Only issue 924 currently has a direct publication-date statement in the recovered forum evidence; do not describe all inferred dates as independently verified publication dates.
